description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON merge patches in Kubernetes, including conflict detection, YAML conversion, and precondition checks.

methods.name: RequireKeyUnchanged
methods.description: Returns a precondition function that fails if the specified key is present in the patch.

methods.name: RequireMetadataKeyUnchanged
methods.description: Creates a precondition function that fails if the specified metadata key is present in the patch.

methods.name: ToYAMLOrError
methods.description: Converts a value to YAML string or returns an error message.

methods.name: toYAML
methods.description: Helper function that marshals a value into YAML format, returning error details if marshaling fails.

methods.name: HasConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts between two JSON interface objects based on overlapping keys with different values.
